headline: Kshitij Polyline Limited intimates Letter of Offer for rights issue of equity shares
sum: Kshitij Polyline Limited, a polyester films and polymer products manufacturer, has filed its Letter of Offer with the NSE and BSE for a rights issue of equity shares. The intimation signals the formal commencement of the rights offering process under SEBI ICDR Regulations.
implication: Rights issues remain a capital-efficient tool for listed issuers to raise funds from existing shareholders while maintaining proportional ownership; key practice points include strict adherence to Section 62 Companies Act shareholder approval thresholds, ICDR disclosure timelines, and NSE/BSE intimation mandates.
detail: Kshitij Polyline Limited, a manufacturer of polyester films, BOPP films, and related polymers, has announced a rights issue of equity shares on 18 August 2026 via formal intimation to the NSE. The company has filed its Letter of Offer (LoF) setting out the terms, ratio, pricing, and timeline for the rights offering. The rights issue is being conducted under the SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 and Section 62 of the Companies Act 2013, both of which govern preferential issues to existing shareholders. As of the announcement date, the full quantum of the raise remains unspecified in publicly available sources, though the 1-for-2 ratio indicates a material capital call.
